title.narrative: Strengthening Climate Adaptation, Resilience, Livelihoods, and Gender Inclusion in Kisumu and Bungoma Counties_Suswatch

description.narrative: This project aims to empower local communities and institutions to manage climate finance in an inclusive, transparent, and sustainable way. Additionally, it connects climate justice with economic justice, recognizing climate change as a major factor influencing local economic development. By focusing on locally led adaptation, the project emphasizes sustainable practices and disaster risk reduction to support economic resilience and minimize losses associated with climate impacts. This project’s primary objective is to enhance climate adaptation, resilience, and economic growth at the community level in Kisumu and Bungoma Counties by promoting inclusive and effective climate finance strategies, sustainable practices, and strengthening local capacity to address climate impacts. This will be achieved by promoting inclusive and effective climate finance strategies, advancing sustainable practices, and strengthening local capacity to address climate challenges. It aims to address the growing climate challenges in Kisumu and Bungoma Counties, including floods, drought, water access, sustainable agriculture, and enhancing community resilience. Through a combination of governance reforms, public accountability and transparency, capacity building, community involvement, promotion of livelihood diversification and gender and social inclusions in participatory community decision-making processes, the project seeks to create a more adaptive and resilient climate framework for the counties. This project will implement concrete, practical cost-effective and multi-stakeholders’ adaptation solutions to promote inclusive and effective climate finance strategies as well as improve the livelihoods of the poor and vulnerable communities in the Kisumu and Bungoma Counties
